result.instructions: This server edits a program of an AKAI S5000/S6000 sampler. Call get_status to see which program is current, list_programs and select_program to change it, and list_parameters to learn the parameter names and what each accepts: the filter, the amplitude envelope, the filter envelope and the two LFOs. Use get_parameters to read values and set_parameter to change one. Values are in the sampler's own units (0 to 100 for most), signed values are plain signed numbers, and choices are named as the sampler's screen names them (for example "2-POLE LP+"). Changes act on the sampler's memory, not on disk.

tools.description: Says whether the sampler answers, how many programs are in its memory and which one is current (with its number of keygroups). Call it first.
tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Sampler status

tools.description: Lists the programs in the sampler's memory with their positions (from 0).
tools.name: list_programs
tools.title: List programs

tools.description: Makes a program of the sampler's memory the current one, by its name or its position (from 0, see list_programs). Every later edit acts on it. Give exactly one of name and index. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.
tools.name: select_program
tools.title: Select a program

tools.description: Lists the parameters of a program that can be read and set: their names, what they accept and what they do. Call it before get_parameters or set_parameter to learn the names, and optionally give a group to list only that group.

group.description: One group: filter, amplitude envelope, filter envelope, lfo 1, lfo 2 ("lfo" is both LFOs).

tools.name: list_parameters
tools.title: List parameters

tools.description: Reads the current values of parameters of the current program: a whole group, or a list of parameter names (see list_parameters). Give exactly one of group and parameters. Reading a keygroup parameter moves the sampler's current keygroup selection.

keygroup.description: Which keygroup of the current program: a number from 1, or "all" (the default). It applies to the keygroup parameters (filter, envelopes); the LFO parameters belong to the program.

parameters.description: Parameter names, for example ["filter cutoff", "filter resonance"].

tools.name: get_parameters
tools.title: Read parameters

tools.description: Sets one parameter of the current program (see list_parameters for the names and what each accepts), then reads it back from the sampler and reports what it holds. The value is a number in the sampler's own units, or the name of a choice such as "2-POLE LP+", or on/off. Nothing is sent when the name or the value is not valid. It acts on the sampler's memory, not on disk: nothing is saved, and the change is lost if the sampler is switched off without saving the program from its front panel.

keygroup.description: Which keygroup of the current program: a number from 1, or "all" (the default). It applies to the keygroup parameters (filter, envelopes); the LFO parameters belong to the program.

parameter.description: The parameter's name, for example "filter cutoff".

value.description: A number, a choice label, or on/off (true/false).

tools.name: set_parameter
tools.title: Set a parameter

Parameters (values are in the sampler's own units):

lfo 2: The program's second low-frequency oscillator.
- lfo 2 rate: 0 to 100. The speed of LFO 2. Per program. Also called: lfo2 speed.
- lfo 2 delay: 0 to 100. The time LFO 2's modulation takes to fade in. Per program.
- lfo 2 depth: 0 to 100. The initial depth of LFO 2's modulation. Per program.
- lfo 2 waveform: one of: SINE (0), TRIANGLE (1), SQUARE (2), SQUARE+ (3), SQUARE- (4), SAW BI (5), SAW UP (6), SAW DOWN (7), RANDOM (8). The waveform of LFO 2, one of nine. Per program. Also called: lfo2 shape.
- lfo 2 retrigger: on or off. Whether LFO 2 starts its cycle again on each new note (re-trigger, LFO 2 only). Per program.
